formula: 0.50 * Skill Overlap + 0.20 * TF-IDF Similarity + 0.30 * Semantic Similarity
rationale: Explicit required skills get the highest weight (50%) to ensure transparent explainability. Semantic embeddings (30%) capture meaning and synonyms across titles and project summaries. TF-IDF (20%) grounds recommendations in exact technical vocabulary. JDS and SDS predictions are strictly excluded.
